lines.text: It’s project time! Make a ScratchJr tap game: three characters that react when tapped, a green-flag start message and something moving forever.
Each one does something funny when tapped.
Use the green flag to say “Tap us!”.
Add a background character that moves forever.
Use 👆 start on tap: the balloon grows 2 times, says “POP!” and hides.
Grow, grow… POP! Great game reaction.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
